name: simple-cross-buy
note: One call, one valid spec. Every symbol and every number in the spec appears in the words: XYZ, 10, 50, 3, 20, 5000, 4.
text: Buy 10 shares of XYZ when the price crosses above its 50 bar simple moving average. Check once at the close. Keep at most 3 positions, no more than 20% of the account in any one of them, no single order over $5,000, and stop for the day if the account falls 4%.
